name: L01
text: There's a war going on right now.

name: L04
text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood,

name: L06
text: against the rulers of the darkness of this world,

name: L07
text: against spiritual wickedness in high places.

name: L08
text: The enemy wants your mind. Your family. Your peace.

name: L09
text: But hear me. You are not alone.

name: L10
text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee,

name: L11
text: to keep thee in all thy ways.

name: L13
text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout,

name: L14
text: with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God.

name: L15
text: So put on the whole armour of God.

name: L17
text: Lord Jesus, cover me. Cover my mind, and my family.

name: L19
text: Type amen if you're standing with me.
